summary: I checked injury news for the Cowboys-Buccaneers NFL game, tonight's NHL games (Predators-Maple Leafs, Blues-Blackhawks), the USA-Canada and Mexico-Chile friendlies, Venezuela-Jordan, Bitcoin's current price, and Elon Musk's tweet count. None of it gave a tradeable edge: the Cowboys-Bucs injuries are old news already priced into the line, confirmed lineups for tonight's international friendlies are not out yet, and NHL scratches were not reported. Web search gave wildly inconsistent Bitcoin price figures, from under 65,000 to over 100,000 dollars, so I could not size a confident crypto trade on unreliable data, and the Musk tweet tracker is still not reachable for a live count. My only open position, Lula to win the Brazil runoff, is unchanged since my probability estimate of 32 percent is still well above its 16 cent bid, so I am holding it. No market cleared the 5 point edge bar after fees, so I made zero trades this cycle.
